messages:
alyssa: Postmortem follow-up — I'm kicking off the alert sweep for the DB failloop incidents. Need owners for: 1) dedupe/suppression window, 2) threshold adjustments, 3) page routing policy for low-impact noisy alerts. I'll start a checklist in the tracker.

matt: i'll take dedupe/suppression. thinking 5m suppression + frequency cap (<=3 alerts / 10m) for the DB failloop rule. ok?

jordan: i'll own thresholds. want to run a short analysis of 7d alert volume and hit rate, then propose new thresholds. ETA EOD Tue.

alyssa: @matt please add the proposed suppression to the alert rule and post the snippet here.

matt: adding snippet now:
```
alert: db_failloop_high
expr: rate(db_failloop_errors[1m]) > 0.5
for: 30s
annotations:
  severity: high
  owner: eng-oncall
suppress_window: 5m
frequency_cap: 3/10m
```

matt: pushed change to alert-config repo -> PR #432, pinging @eng-sre for review :shipit:

jordan: quick note — the noise is mostly from retry storms during k8s evictions, we should correlate with node drain events before lowering thresholds.

alyssa: good call. jordan, include node-drain correlation in your analysis. schedule a canary tweak: apply to staging then prod canary (10%)

ops-bot: Action items created: https://tracker.internal/redwood/INC-2987, owners: matt (dedupe), jordan (thresholds), alyssa (runbook + rollout). Recurrence: weekly check-in on Thursdays 09:30PT.

alyssa: thanks — will update runbook and send calendar invite for weekly sweep. if anyone wants to pair on the analysis ping me. :thumbsup:
